title: Honey Yogurt Cheesecake
hookLine: Greek-inspired honey yogurt cheesecake with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Crush the biscuits and most of the almonds inside a plastic food bag using a rolling pin. Mix with the butter, then press into the bottom of a deep, oval, 23cm dish (or something similar in size – a roasting tin, baking dish or cake tin will work). Bake for 10 mins until crisp. Incorporate {m53007_1}, {m53007_2}, {m53007_3}, and {m53007_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure digestive biscuits first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir or mash together the yogurt and mascarpone, then whisk in the eggs, one at a time. Stir in the lemon and orange zests, then stir in most of the honey, reserving about 3 tbsp. Spread over the biscuit base, cover loosely with foil and cook for 1 hr. Remove the foil and cook for 15 mins more until lightly golden and the top is firm with just the slightest wobble in the middle. Leave to cool. Can be kept in the fridge for up to 2 days. Incorporate {m53007_5}, {m53007_6}, {m53007_7}, {m53007_8}, {m53007_9}, and {m53007_10} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Honey Yogurt Cheesecake & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: To serve, scatter with almonds, drizzle over the remaining honey, and hand around fresh fruit to go with it. Let Honey Yogurt Cheesecake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
